title: Lamentations Bible Quiz - Chapter 4
description: Ten questions on Lamentations 4: dimmed gold, hunger in the streets, and a word to the daughter of Edom.

questions.text: What does the first verse say is poured out at the head of every street?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 4:1 says the gold has become dim and the stones of the sanctuary are poured out at the head of every street.

questions.text: The precious sons of Zion, comparable to fine gold, are now esteemed as what?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 4:2 says the precious sons of Zion are esteemed as earthen pitchers, the work of the hands of the potter.

answers.text: Earthen pitchers made by the potter

questions.text: In verse 3 the daughter of my people has become cruel, like what creatures in the wilderness?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 4:3 says that, unlike the jackals who nurse their young, the daughter of my people has become cruel, like the ostriches in the wilderness.

questions.text: Whose tongue clings to the roof of his mouth for thirst?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 4:4 says the tongue of the nursing child clings to the roof of his mouth for thirst, and the young children ask bread with no one to break it for them.

questions.text: What do those who were brought up in purple now do?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 4:5 says that those who ate delicacies are desolate in the streets and those brought up in purple embrace dunghills.

answers.text: They beg at the city gates

questions.text: The iniquity of the daughter of my people is said to be greater than the sin of which city?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 4:6 says her iniquity is greater than the sin of Sodom, which was overthrown as in a moment.

questions.text: Her nobles were once whiter than milk. What is their appearance now blacker than?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 4:8 says their appearance is blacker than a coal, their skin clings to their bones and is withered.

questions.text: According to verse 9, those who are killed with the sword are better off than those who are killed by what?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 4:9 says those killed with the sword are better than those killed with hunger, who pine away for lack of the fruits of the field.

questions.text: What did the kings of the earth and the inhabitants of the world not believe?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 4:12 says they did not believe that the adversary and the enemy would enter into the gates of Jerusalem.

answers.text: That Zion's walls would ever be rebuilt
That the enemy would enter the gates of Jerusalem
That a prophet would be sent to Zion
That the priests would be scattered

questions.text: Which daughter, dwelling in the land of Uz, is told to rejoice and be glad?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 4:21 tells the daughter of Edom, who dwells in the land of Uz, to rejoice and be glad, but says the cup will pass through to her also.
